title: Maximal ideal and structural map in an affine strict-henselization chart
statement: Let S be a scheme, Ω an algebraically closed field, R a commutative ring, i : Spec R → S an open immersion and xR : Spec Ω → Spec R. Put s = xR followed by i and C = [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], the coordinate ring of S_(s). There exist a local-ring structure on C and a ring map ρ : R → C such that Spec(ρ) followed by i is [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map] and the maximal ideal of C is the extension under ρ of the prime xR(closedPoint Ω).

source.place: Tag 04HX, affine-chart colimit identification; Tag 04GW, triple colimit; Tag 04GP, property (4). Sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04HX, /04GW and /04GP.

proof.text: Apply etale_local_ring_triples to i and xR. Retain the chart equivalence E, the diagram isomorphism delta, its R-map compatibility, colimit cocones cn and ct, and the colimit isomorphism t with its coprojection formula. Apply strictHenselization_triples over the relative separable closure K to obtain a local triple colimit c, its structure map rho, and maximalIdeal(c) = p.map(rho).

The source smallStrictHenselizationCocone has the full affine strict henselization as vertex. Whisker cn along the opposite of the inverse small-model equivalence followed by strictHenselizationAffineInclusion. Finality makes this a universal cocone. Its uniqueness comparison with the source small cocone identifies strictHenselization with cn.pt, with the stated coprojection equation. Compose with t and the unique comparison ct.pt to c.pt.

Choose a small representative j isomorphic to the pointed affine chart (Spec R,i,xR), and let g:Spec B to Spec R be its scheme map. The diagram-isomorphism structural equation, the formula for t, and the ct-to-c uniqueness equation identify the small cocone leg preceded by GammaSpecIso(R).inv and g.appTop with rho followed by the inverse comparison. Apply Spec, use naturality of isoSpec.inv and g followed by i equal to the neighbourhood structure map, and apply the source strictHenselizationStructuralMap_eq for the full affine cone. This proves the structural-map equation for strictLocalizationToBase.

Transport locality from c.pt along the inverse ring equivalence. The source map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal identity, the triple maximal-ideal formula, and Ideal.map_map give the extended-prime equality for the transported rho. For consumers using the small representative colimit, the canonical smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso transports this conclusion. Its inverse coprojection formula and the defining equations of the two structure maps show that its spectrum commutes with the structure maps; map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal and Ideal.map_map transport the ideal equation.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_chart_maximalIdeal
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (i : Spec R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (xR : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R) :
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing (strictHenselization (xR ≫ i)))
      (ρ : R ⟶ strictHenselization (xR ≫ i)),
      Spec.map ρ ≫ i = strictLocalizationToBase (xR ≫ i) ∧
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (strictHenselization (xR ≫ i)) =
        (xR (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)).asIdeal.map ρ.hom
